title: Radiotherapy Suite — Minimum Requirements
notes: Section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 39) — see the common all-institutions module; not repeated as items here.

items.requirement: Rooms and spaces shall be provided as necessary to accommodate the functional program.
Simulator, accelerator, and cobalt rooms shall be sized to accommodate the equipment and patient access on a stretcher, medical staff access to the equipment and patient, and service access.
Radiation protection requirements: cobalt, linear accelerators, and simulation rooms require radiation protection.
Layouts shall be designed to prevent the escape of radioactive particles.
Openings into the room, including doors, ductwork, vents, and electrical raceways and conduits, shall be baffled to prevent direct exposure to other areas of the facility.
Flooring shall be adequate to meet load requirements for equipment, patients, and personnel.
Provision for wiring raceways, ducts, or conduit shall be made in floors and ceilings.
Ceiling-mounted equipment shall have properly designed rigid support structures located above the finished ceiling.

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite shall be provided. Sharing of these areas between the radiotherapy suite and other areas is permitted if required by the functional program of the health facility.
items.alternatives: sharing of support areas between the radiotherapy suite and other areas is permitted if required by the functional program of the health facility

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: Exam rooms for each treatment room. Each exam room shall be a minimum 10 square metres, and equipped with a hand-washing station.

measurement.expected: minimum 10 square metres per exam room as stated

items.quantity: exam rooms for each treatment room

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: A stretcher hold area located adjacent to the treatment rooms, screened for privacy, and combined with a seating area for outpatients.

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: Patient gowning area with safe storage for valuables and clothing shall be provided. At least one space should be large enough for staff-assisted dressing.
items.quantity: at least one space large enough for staff-assisted dressing

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: Darkroom should be convenient to the treatment room(s) and the quality control area. Where daylight processing is used, the darkroom may be minimal for emergency use. If automatic film processors are used, a receptacle of adequate size with hot and cold water for cleaning the processor racks shall be provided either in the darkroom or nearby.
items.conditional: where daylight processing is used, the darkroom may be minimal for emergency use; if automatic film processors are used, a cleaning receptacle with hot and cold water shall be provided in the darkroom or nearby

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: Film storage area for unprocessed film.

items.section: Support areas for the radiotherapy suite
items.requirement: Housekeeping room equipped with service sink or floor receptor and large enough for equipment or supplies storage.
